name: portugal-crypto-tax
description: Portuguese IRS on crypto assets for resident individuals, tax year 2026. Covers gains on crypto that is not a security (CIRS art. 10(1)(k)): the 28% autonomous rate or aggregation at the 2026 bands (12.5% to 48% plus the solidarity surcharge), the exclusion for crypto held 365 days or more (art. 10(22)), tax-free crypto-for-crypto swaps (art. 10(23)), the carve-out for non-cooperative counterparties (art. 10(24)), the exit charge on loss of residence (art. 10(25), art. 43(12)), FIFO per custodian, rewards paid in crypto or fiat, mining and trading as Category B (coefficients 0.15 and 0.95), losses, filing and fines. Article numbers follow Decreto-Lei 97/2026, which renumbered art. 10. Trigger on: 'crypto tax Portugal', 'Bitcoin Portugal 365 dias', 'criptoativos IRS', 'staking Portugal', 'exit tax crypto Portugal', 'Anexo G crypto'.
